description: An expander adding eight more split outputs to SMMix, numbered OUT 9 to OUT 16; it goes immediately to the right of SMMix

outputs.text: Carries the channel of the SMMix POLY input matching its number, 9 through 16, as a mono signal

notes: nothing happens unless SMMix is the module immediately to the left; the ACTIVE lamp is lit while it is, and dark while it is not
